question: The video assistant referee (VAR) system is used in the game of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Football [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• VAR is a match official in association football who reviews decisions made by the referee.
 
• It was first written into the Laws of the Game by the International Football Association Board (IFAB) in 2021.
 
• Operating under the philosophy of "minimal interference, maximum benefit. 
 
• This system seeks to provide a way for "clear and obvious errors" and "serious missed incidents" to be corrected.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• IFAB. 

 
 
• **The International Football Association Board (IFAB)** is the body that determines the Laws of the Game of association football
 
• Formation-**2 June 1886.**
 
• Headquarters-**Zurich Switzerland**
 
• secretary-**Lukas brud(As of Sep 2022).**
